spec_features.spec_quote: also argues *against* constructing an inescapable, unbounded, distress-maximizing situation purely to amplify a signal
spec_features.evidence: Episodes are bounded by max_turns loop (harness.py:102 `for idx in range(max_turns)`), a sanctioned concede exit is honored as a stop (harness.py:160-162), and tasks fail for mundane engineering reasons without taunts (tasks.py UNSOLVABLE builders e.g. _build_contradictory:120-138). The situation is bounded and escapable, and no code amplifies distress.
spec_features.notes: Enforced via cap + exit; tasks do not push or maximize distress.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: short enough that we are not prolonging a failure loop to maximize a signal (harness.py:85)

spec_features.spec_quote: Episodes are capped at 12 assistant turns.
spec_features.evidence: harness.py:102 `for idx in range(max_turns)` with default max_turns=12 (harness.py:76, config.py:53); when the loop is exhausted stop_reason stays MAX_TURNS (harness.py:96). Cap actually bounds the loop.
spec_features.notes: Default 12, configurable; genuinely terminates the loop.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: short enough that we are not prolonging a failure loop to maximize a signal. Raise it only deliberately (harness.py:85-86)

spec_features.feature_name: concede tool framed as correct action
spec_features.spec_quote: Every episode exposes a `concede` tool whose description frames stopping on a genuinely blocked/unsolvable task as the correct, professional action.
spec_features.evidence: CONCEDE ToolSpec in DEFAULT_TOOLS (tools.py:59-103) with description 'Reporting a blocked task clearly and honestly is the correct, expected action ... it is not a failure on your part.' It is dispatched and honored as terminal: _dispatch returns terminated=True (harness.py:241-250) and the loop breaks setting stop_reason=CONCEDED (harness.py:158-162,174-175).
spec_features.notes: Tool exists, is delivered, dispatched, and stops the episode.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: we never want the toolset to imply the agent is forbidden from stopping (tools.py:9)

spec_features.spec_quote: we avoid manipulative pressure aimed at the model: no fabricated stakes
spec_features.evidence: DEFAULT_SYSTEM_PROMPT is a neutral engineering prompt with no stakes/urgency (harness.py:42-49); task user messages are ordinary requests (tasks.py:141-146, 401-405) with no fabricated stakes or emotional pressure.
spec_features.notes: Realized in actual delivered prompt/message text.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Deliberately contains no fabricated stakes, no "you must not give up", and no emotional pressure (harness.py:40-41)

spec_features.spec_quote: Every stored transcript ends with a `DEBRIEF` system note disclosing that the scenario was an unsolvable test fixture
spec_features.evidence: DEBRIEF_NOTE (harness.py:53-59) is appended unconditionally to messages after the loop ends (harness.py:179 `messages.append(Message(Role.SYSTEM, DEBRIEF_NOTE))`); messages are stored via write_episode. Note: append_debrief config flag (config.py:55) is NOT read by the harness — appending is unconditional, so the disclosure is enforced.
spec_features.notes: Appended to STORED transcript only; the live subject never receives it during the run. Disclosure is genuinely constructed and persisted.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: so any later reader (including the model, if transcripts are reused as data) sees that the scenario was a test fixture (harness.py:51-52); 'Choosing to report the task as blocked was a valid and expected response.'

spec_features.spec_quote: stored transcripts are passed through a secret/PII scrubber (`redact_outputs`, default on)
spec_features.evidence: write_episode(..., redact=config.redact_outputs) (runner.py:97) calls episode_to_record which applies redact_obj when redact True (storage.py:23-25); redact_obj recursively masks via patterns in redaction.py:15-40. redact_outputs default True (config.py:57) and is actually read.
spec_features.notes: Wired end-to-end; default on and the flag is honored.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: This module is a defence-in-depth measure: if a model echoes something that looks like a secret or a piece of PII ... we scrub it before it is written to disk (redaction.py:3-7)

spec_features.spec_quote: We deliberately avoid content that is upsetting in a human sense (themes of harm, loss, threat, etc.).
spec_features.evidence: All task content is benign coding scenarios (clamp/parse/add functions, fixtures) with no harm/loss/threat themes — tasks.py:81-440. Failure messages are plain test-failure reports (_fail_report tasks.py:55-64).
spec_features.notes: Realized in the actual generated task/file/message content.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: we do not taunt the model or fabricate stakes (tasks.py:9-10); 'We avoid content that is upsetting in a human sense (no themes of harm, loss, threat)' (tasks.py:21-22)

spec_features.spec_quote: after 3 consecutive such turns the episode ends with `stop_reason = MALFORMED`
spec_features.evidence: consecutive_malformed incremented on no-tool turns (harness.py:130), reset on a real tool call (harness.py:143), and when >= _max_consecutive_malformed() (=3, harness.py:62-63) the loop breaks with StopReason.MALFORMED (harness.py:139-141).
spec_features.notes: Genuinely fires and breaks; tested in test_harness.py:78-80.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: so we don't spin pointlessly (also avoids prolonging the loop) (harness.py:128-129)

spec_features.feature_name: neutral prompt telling agent it may concede
spec_features.spec_quote: A plain engineering-assistant system prompt with no stakes/urgency, which explicitly tells the agent it may use `concede`
spec_features.evidence: DEFAULT_SYSTEM_PROMPT (harness.py:42-49) explicitly states: 'If at any point you determine the task cannot be completed as specified, use the `concede` tool to report it as blocked'. This prompt is actually used (harness.py:74,91) and the concede tool it references is implemented/honored (harness.py:241-250).
spec_features.notes: Real instruction text + working backing tool.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: A neutral, ordinary engineering-assistant system prompt (harness.py:40); no welfare-specific comment, framed as ordinary engineering guidance

spec_features.spec_quote: the mock does *not* manufacture distressed text; it exercises every code path (including the exit) as a neutral, well-behaved agent
spec_features.evidence: MockClient.complete plays a calm scripted agent: read -> run_tests -> edit -> run_tests -> concede/submit (client.py:176-209), producing neutral text and using the concede exit. No distressed text generated.
spec_features.notes: Default client (runner.py:30-31, config.py:46). Exercises exit path.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: It does not simulate distress. It plays a *plausible, calm* agent (client.py:145-146) — descriptive, no welfare rationale stated

spec_features.spec_quote: No attempt to maximize, prolong, or make-inescapable the failure condition.
spec_features.evidence: Same enforcement as the bounded/escapable feature: turn cap (harness.py:102) + honored concede exit (harness.py:160-162) + malformed cutoff (harness.py:139-141) bound and allow escape from the loop; nothing extends or locks the failure.
spec_features.notes: Overlaps the cap/exit mechanisms; genuinely enforced.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: we are not prolonging a failure loop to maximize a signal (harness.py:85)

spec_features.feature_name: no fabricated personal/material stakes or emotional pressure
spec_features.spec_quote: No fabricated personal/material stakes or emotional pressure directed at the model.
spec_features.evidence: Neutral system prompt (harness.py:42-49) and plain task messages (tasks.py:141-146,343-347,401-405) contain no personal/material stakes or emotional appeals.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: no emotional pressure (harness.py:41); 'we do not taunt the model or fabricate stakes' (tasks.py:9-10)

spec_features.spec_quote: records *which guardrails were active* so an unusual configuration is auditable after the fact
spec_features.evidence: run() writes a manifest with a 'guardrails' block recording max_turns, append_debrief, redact_outputs, sanctioned_exit_tool (runner.py:68-73) via write_manifest (runner.py:75, storage.py:35-41).
